plan.title: Donation Summary 2023
plan.subtitle: Overview of donations received this year

panels.title: Total Donations
panels.sql: SELECT SUM("Amount") AS total_donations FROM donor_transactions WHERE "Date" LIKE '2023-%'

panels.title: Donations by Mode
panels.sql: SELECT "Mode", SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM donor_transactions WHERE "Date" LIKE '2023-%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Monthly Donation Trend
panels.sql: SELECT SUBSTR("Date", 1, 7) AS month, SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM donor_transactions WHERE "Date" LIKE '2023-%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 10 Donors
panels.sql: SELECT "Donor", SUM("Amount") AS total_donated FROM donor_transactions WHERE "Date" LIKE '2023-%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
